author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಅಂತೆಕಂತೆಯ ಸುತ್ತ ಯಾಕಲೆವೆ ನೀಮನುಜ
ಸ್ವಂತಿಕೆಯ ಬೆಳೆಸುತಲೆ ನಿಜವನೀನರಿಯೊ
ಗ್ರಂಥಾವಲೋಕನವು ಅನುಭವವು ಜತೆಗೂಡೆ
ಸಂತನಾಗುವೆ ನೀನು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Why do you wander round rumour and hearsay, O man?
grow your own originality and know the truth yourself;
when reading of books joins with experience,
you will become a sage, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Stop living on hearsay. Think for yourself and find out what is true. Study combined with lived experience is what makes a person wise.
